text: ちょっと　しゃべり　すぎたわい　わしの　ポケモン　じまんを　おとなしく　きいてた　おれいに　…これは　きもち　じゃ！

structure.jp: ちょっと　しゃべり　すぎたわい
structure.en: I talked a bit too much

structure.jp: わしの　ポケモン　じまんを　おとなしく　きいてた　おれいに
structure.en: as thanks for listening quietly to my Pokémon bragging

structure.jp: …これは　きもち　じゃ！
structure.en: ...this is a token of my feelings!

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a verb with its ます cut off means doing it too much. しゃべり　すぎた = 'talked too much'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わしの　ポケモン　じまんを　おとなしく　きいてた　おれい
patterns.explanation: The whole phrase ending in きいてた (short for きいていた) tells you what the thanks is for. きいてた　おれい = 'thanks for having listened'.

patterns.name: 〜に (as)
patterns.explanation: に after a word like 'thanks' or 'souvenir' says what something is given as. おれいに = 'as a thank-you'.
